svg.title: DDM501 Face and Voice Integrity - System Architecture
svg.desc: Three lanes: training and data platform; CI/CD deployment and batch verification; monitoring, guarded policy promotion and rollback. Current single-host Docker Compose implementation.
svg.text: System architecture / Company batch verification + guarded MLOps lifecycle
Face and Voice: independent threshold policies
FastAPI | Streamlit | Airflow | MLflow | storage | monitoring
On demand | biometric_model_pipeline | training tenant: demo
Company owns exams, capture timing and business decisions
Immediate JSON result to company backend
Async callback to the same backend
PRETRAINED ENCODERS | One API process | Canary selects threshold policy inside FastAPI | Ordinary raw captures discarded by default
Drift, trusted evidence and guarded rollout
Promote, preserve champion or restore a previous version
Quality PSI / embedding MMD / score PSI
Evidently reports do not trigger a second training path. Missing labels pause lifecycle progression.
POLICY ROLLOUT | Separate Face / Voice state machines
Final stage passes: commit new champion
Offline + shadow failures also preserve the champion. Thresholds are calibrated; encoders stay fixed.
Synthetic data | SQLite + file MLflow + separate volume
Promote / fail at 25% / reset; shared host + Airflow. Simulation alerts use their own receiver.
